column2: GL Beginning Balances represent the closing trial balance from the legacy system as of the last closed period before go-live. Validate with: python workday_financial_validator.py beginning_balances_gl this_file.csv 3
Ledger_Account: Must exactly match a Ledger Account ID from the COA (Ledger Accounts) load
Period: Format YYYY-MM (e.g., 2025-12 for December 2025 — the last closed period in legacy)
Debit_Amount and Credit_Amount: Enter positive amounts only. Use EITHER Debit OR Credit per row, not both
CRITICAL: Total Debits must equal Total Credits (trial balance must balance). Run this check in Excel before loading: =SUMIF(E:E,">0",E:E) should equal =SUMIF(F:F,">0",F:F)
Reconciliation gate: GL balance per Workday after load must match legacy trial balance by account, by currency, within $0.01
Worktag allocation: If GL balances need to be split by Cost Center, create one row per Cost Center allocation per account
Load order: Object 8 — LAST object to load in the sequence. All master data (COA, Cost Centers, Suppliers, Customers) must be loaded first
This template represents ACTUAL ledger balances. If loading Budget balances separately, use a separate template and load type
